purpose: Blinded construct-validity review of forecast-time regime phenomena; no rainfall-skill claim
year_status: Previously consumed rainfall test years; expert labels are a new construct-validity check only
population: Forecast-side INCLUDED GEFSv12 reforecast c00 JJAS cases on 10-22 N, 68-80 E
sampling: For each year x JJAS month x Day 1/2/3 stratum, choose the two complete cases with smallest SHA256(case_id); no target, objective label or detector score used
reviewer_view: separately inventoried dated bulletin if later supplied
review_rule: Two independent reviewers per case; cited rationale for positive; reason for uncertainty; preserve original forms and adjudicate blind to scores
western_disturbance_scope: JJAS central-western India maps alone are insufficient; winter/broad-domain corpus required for rainfall relevance
